_readme: Machine-readable owner/authority map for the live OpenUI synthesis stack (SGS-001, SLM-435).
Every `subsystems[].owner_module` must exist and contain every listed owner_symbols entry as a
class/def/constant name, checked by scripts/verify_ownership_map.py (static AST/text check, no imports).
`authority_tier` must be one of the keys in `authority_tiers`.
Downstream SGS/VCE/PCT/SRP/SIE/RSP work (the rest of the Compatibility and ownership gate milestone) must
cite an existing `subsystems[].id` as its extension point, or set `new_owner_justified: true` with a
one-sentence `justification` explaining why no existing owner fits. See downstream_extension_map.

authority_tiers.compiler-hard: Deterministic, grammar/contract-derived authority. Wrong output is a bug, never a soft preference; verified by static/AST checks, not sampling.
authority_tiers.verifier-hard: Authority derived from running the G0-G12 verifier stack or an equivalent oracle against a candidate; pass/fail is binding, not advisory.
authority_tiers.advisory-learned: Model- or heuristic-derived signal used to rank or prioritize among options that are already legal under a compiler-hard or verifier-hard gate. Never authorizes an illegal output and never substitutes for a missing verifier-hard check.
authority_tiers.oracle-diagnostic: Ground-truth substitution or intervention used to diagnose or attribute causes (e.g. plan-oracle substitution, counterfactual probes). Used for measurement and repair-target construction, not served to users.
authority_tiers.evaluation-only: Scoring, telemetry, or reporting surface. Observes and records; does not gate production decode and is not cited as decode-time authority.

subsystems.name: SemanticPlanV1 program-side plan contract
subsystems.notes: Versioned, provenance-aware, pack-neutral plan IR. Single definition site; all consumers (models/semantic_plan_factors.py, data/semantic_contrast/transforms.py, data/semantic_plan/*) import from here.

subsystems.name: PromptSemanticRequirementsV1 prompt-side partial requirements contract
subsystems.notes: SGS-004 extractor/canonicalize live beside the contract under data/semantic_plan/requirements_extract.py and requirements_canonicalize.py (extract_prompt_requirements, ExtractorRule, EXTRACTOR_RULES, GoldTargetAccessError, canonicalize_requirements, requirement_fact_fingerprints). Advisory-only; refuses gold/target kwargs. Owner_symbols stay on the contract module because verify_ownership_map binds symbols to a single owner_module file.

subsystems.name: VerifiedSynthesisProblemV1 pack-neutral synthesis-request envelope
subsystems.notes: SGS-007 (SLM-444): new owner layered on semantic_plan, verifier_gate_stack, and dsl_pack_registry_canonical without duplicating any of them -- carries a PromptSemanticRequirementsV1 verbatim, references verifier/evaluator identities by string, and bounds search resources without granting search authority. Excludes authority in {compiler-hard, verifier-hard} at the type level, mirroring prompt_requirements, so no request can declare itself compiler-certified merely through this envelope. Generated JSON Schema: src/slm_training/resources/verified_synthesis_problem.schema.json (scripts/sync_verified_synthesis_problem_schema.py --check).

subsystems.name: CompiledGoalConstraintSetV1 compiled goal-constraint contract
subsystems.notes: PGS-A01 (SLM-494): compiled, authority-labeled goal constraints layered on verified_synthesis_problem, prompt_requirements, semantic_plan, and verifier_gate_stack without duplicating request-side or plan-side contracts. may_prune is fail-closed to independently exact sources (pack_contract, verification_requirement) with EXACT completeness and compiler-hard/verifier-hard authority only. Generated JSON Schema: src/slm_training/resources/compiled_goal_constraint_set.schema.json (scripts/sync_compiled_goal_constraint_set_schema.py --check).

subsystems.name: Goal-verifier profiles, terminal evidence, and goal-aware support
subsystems.notes: PGS-B01/B02/C01/C02/C03 (SLM-497/498/499/500/501): digest-bound GoalVerifierProfileV1 and GoalTerminalEvidenceV1 contracts; GoalSupportProvider sidecars over VSS oracle replay; DomainObstructionCoreV1 bounded hitting sets; GoalActionEvidenceV1/GoalDomainAdequacyReportV1 domain-adequacy classification; OpenUIGoalVerifier terminal composition in openui_support.py. Generated JSON Schema: goal_verifier_profile.schema.json, goal_terminal_evidence.schema.json, goal_support_result.schema.json, domain_obstruction_core.schema.json, goal_action_evidence.schema.json, goal_domain_adequacy_report.schema.json (scripts/sync_goal_support_schema.py --check).

subsystems.name: Deterministic goal-constraint compiler (PGS-A02)
subsystems.notes: PGS-A02 (SLM-495): deterministic compilation from VerifiedSynthesisProblemV1, GenerationRequest, and DslPack into CompiledGoalConstraintSetV1. Structured request/pack/verifier facts compile exact; RequirementFact values compile only through a closed rule table into advisory/oracle/evaluation predicates; unknown statements land in uncompiled_source_ids. Does not modify SGS-004 extractor authority.

subsystems.name: SyGuS/SemGuS capability report over VerifiedSynthesisProblemV1
subsystems.notes: SGS-008/SLM-455. The downstream_extension_map row for SGS-008 predicted extending dsl_pack_registry_canonical/completion_domain directly (new_owner_justified: false); implementation instead built a small, self-contained new module over verified_synthesis_problem's envelope, so it is registered here as its own subsystem rather than force-fit into pack.py/grammar_capabilities.py, whose owner_symbols it does not touch. Reuses grammar_capabilities.py's UnsupportedCapabilityV1 status/reason idiom (generalized to representable/non_representable/extension_required) and symbolic_expr_ir.py's BINARY_OPERATORS/UNARY_OPERATORS for the one demonstrably faithful fragment (a symbolic-regression synth-fun grammar); every other requirement-bearing element (verification requirements, prompt facts/ambiguity groups, objectives, search budget, evidence provenance) is reported non_representable/extension_required with a reason, never silently dropped. Introduces no solver dependency and calls no external solver, so nothing here can widen exact compiler support. conformance='inspired_interoperability' documents that the emitted SyGuS-IF-shaped text is not standards-conformant (no (check-synth), no example-table constraints).

subsystems.name: Mechanism disposition and stale-evidence supersession reports
subsystems.notes: SGS-009/SLM-456 (new_owner_justified: true, extension_points: [] in the downstream_extension_map -- genuinely new). Generalizes the SLM-160/SPV4-02 narrative precedent (SPVMechanismDisposition, docs/design/semantic-planning-valid-state-disposition.md) into reusable code covering any mechanism, not just the SPV family; reuses that module's Disposition enum directly rather than redefining the same seven values. Is the canonical EVIDENCE_CLASSES registry PCT-007 (models/decode_stats.py's MECHANISM_EVIDENCE_CLASSES) named as still-Backlog when it stayed a caller-declared advisory field. Fails closed on both AC1/AC2: adopt_primary/adopt_optional requires evidence_class in {measured,promotable,ship} plus non-empty activation_evidence (a wired-but-unmeasured mechanism can never be recorded as adopted), and evidence_class='fixture' can never pair with default_state='on'. Supersession is a pure, append-only pointer between two same-mechanism_id records; the superseded record is never rewritten or removed, only linked. Scope note: ships the reusable schema/validation/generator proven against a fixture matrix (the issue's own validation ask), not a completed audit of every real mechanism across the current SGS/VCE/PCT/SRP/SIE/RSP backlog -- that data-entry pass is follow-on work, mirroring how SLM-160's own audit was a separate pass from building its harness.

subsystems.name: Semantic-failure taxonomy / evidence labeling
subsystems.notes: Deliberately an adapter over the G0-G12 verifier stack; it versions/labels verifier evidence, it does not re-score it.

subsystems.name: G0-G12 deterministic verifier gate sequence
subsystems.notes: Canonical G0(Lexical)..G12(HumanAudit) gate numbering and pass/fail. Any module that reimplements gate numbering instead of importing this Gate enum is a duplicate risk.

subsystems.notes: Re-imports Gate/GATE_NAMES from data/verify/stack.py directly; correct precedent for reuse, not a second gate authority.

subsystems.notes: Fixture-only interim baseline (SPV2-05). Its own docstring defers real verifier-backed counterfactual action values to SLM-131/VSS (counterfactual_probe). Not dead code; a documented pending supersession. VCE-002/SLM-446 added RepairResidualV1 -- a pure projection of SemanticRepairRecordV1/ConflictSlice (plus optional VCE-001 VerifierWitnessV1 reconciliation) into an advisory residual-obligation view; it owns no new authority and is not a second repair registry.

subsystems.name: Plan-level oracle substitution
subsystems.notes: Distinct from semantic_repair's corruption-repair targets: this substitutes ground-truth oracle values for factor-wise diagnosis, not corruption recovery. VCE-004/SLM-447 added PlanInterventionRecordV1/apply_plan_intervention -- an immutable, replayable paired baseline/intervention observation (before/after plan hashes, declared-vs-observed changed factors, frozen model/request/seed/verifier/hardware identity, downstream decision/quality/compute evidence) plus filter_manifest_safe to exclude contamination-bannered records from any manifest. VCE-005/SLM-458 extended PlanSource with 'destructive'/'random' (PlanOracleSubstitutor.apply permutes baseline's own existing per-factor content -- same element count, matched serialization/work -- rather than reading any second plan; neither is contamination-bannered, since neither ever saw real oracle content), added select_shuffled_oracle (content-only compatibility key over archetype id + structure sizes, never identity.source_program_fingerprint/prompt_context_hash, so a shuffled control cannot access target identity through those hidden fields), and build_baseline_intervention (an explicit, first-class matched-telemetry no-intervention control -- same apply_plan_intervention bookkeeping as every other arm). No new record schema, no second substitution authority.

subsystems.notes: LDI3-03/SLM-131 relative rollout probe plus PGS-D01/SLM-502 distinct goal-support path (GoalSupportProbeInputs, run_goal_support_probe). Named by semantic_repair.py as the eventual authority for verifier-backed repair action values -- currently a parallel, not yet merged, track.

subsystems.notes: Timing/step-count/fastpath hit-miss telemetry collected during inference/eval. PCT-003/SLM-450 added src/slm_training/harnesses/model_build/cold_warm_bench.py (BenchTrialV1, HardwareIdentityV1, run_cold_trial/run_warm_trial/summarize_trials), a fresh-subprocess cold and in-process warm benchmark harness reusing this owner's MEASUREMENT_STAGES/COMPLETENESS_STATES taxonomy directly rather than inventing a second one; extends the bench_* script family (scripts/bench_accel.py etc.), introduces no new telemetry authority. PCT-007/SLM-452 added MechanismActivationV1/build_mechanism_activation directly in decode_stats.py: a common eligible/invoked/abstained/no_op/changed_top_choice/changed_final_program envelope any optional mechanism can emit, fail-closed against representing a never-active mechanism as a successful intervention. evidence_class/default_state stay caller-declared advisory fields (MECHANISM_EVIDENCE_CLASSES is illustrative only) pending SGS-009/SLM-456 (still Backlog), which is the actual future owner of a canonical disposition enum -- this does not fabricate that registry ahead of it.

subsystems.name: Runtime-level telemetry sink

PCT-002/SLM-449 added a sibling submodule src/slm_training/runtime/telemetry/replay_bundle.py (ReplayBundleV1, build_replay_bundle, append_replay_bundle, iter_replay_bundles, mirror_bundle_best_effort, replay_bundle_integrity_ok -- re-exported through this package's __init__.py) composing DecodeIdentityV1 (decode_telemetry) and solver_replay_violations (solver_replay) into a compact, content-bound, offline-replayable evidence envelope; introduces no new decode/verifier authority and no new store (persistence reuses any ReplayBundleStore-shaped append-only store the caller already has). INTEG-01/SLM-528 projects ReplayBundleV1 (with DecodeStats / MechanismActivation / VerifierWitness) into formal/proof_trace.py::CanonicalProofTraceV1 — a pure projection adapter reusing KERN-06 Event/cost vocabulary; introduces no second runtime recorder and never claims abstract refinement.

Only 7 importers, all under dsl/packs/*, harnesses/reasoning/bench.py, and their tests. subsystems.notes: DSL_TOKENIZER_VERSION=5, machine-checked against docs/design/agent-harness-parity-audit.md ("DSL_TOKENIZER_VERSION stays 5") by scripts/verify_ownership_map.py CONTRACT_VERSION_CHECKS (SGS-002/SLM-436). Distinct from choice_codec (models/choice_tokenizer.py): this is the lexer-native tokenizer, the choice codec is the fastpath alternative.

subsystems.name: Deterministic choice-sequence codec
subsystems.notes: Fastpath alternative to open-vocab tokenization. Coexists deliberately with the DSL-native tokenizer (is_choice_tokenizer discriminator); not a duplicate.

subsystems.name: Grammar production codec
subsystems.notes: Related production-level codec consumed alongside choice_codec.

subsystems.name: Typed symbolic-expression IR, codec, and symbol table
subsystems.notes: SRP-002/SLM-453. New pack-local subsystem for the symbolic-regression pack (SRP-001/SLM-441, owner symbolic_regression_pack.py), pre-authorized by the downstream_extension_map row for SRP-002 (new_owner_justified: true, layer under output_contract, do not fork it). Variables and coefficients are opaque indices only -- never names or free numeric literals -- so the structural codec's output space is symbol-only by construction without introducing a second OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION or reusing production_codec's OpenUI-specific encode/decode logic. Supersedes the untyped dict-shaped expression tree in symbolic_regression_pack.py as the canonical structural form; the Lark surface grammar registered there (dsl/grammar/backends/symbolic_regression.py) remains input-surface syntax only.

subsystems.name: Vectorized NumPy evaluator with explicit numerical-domain policies
subsystems.notes: SRP-003/SLM-461. New pack-local subsystem for the symbolic-regression pack, pre-authorized by the downstream_extension_map row for SRP-003 (new_owner_justified: true, extension_point dsl_pack_registry_canonical -- this evaluator is consumed by/registered through that registry, it does not fork it). Evaluates symbolic_expr_ir's typed AST (VarRef/CoefficientHole/OpApply) over NumPy arrays via a fixed, hardcoded per-operator dispatch table -- no eval/exec/getattr/importlib path exists. Honors symbolic_regression_pack.SymbolicRegressionProblemV1.numeric_domain_policy (reject_nonfinite/allow_nonfinite), which no evaluator previously consulted. Supersedes symbolic_regression_pack.evaluate_expression for real search/fitting use; that scalar reference evaluator is kept only to prove the parse/evaluate round trip. SRP-004 (SLM-465) is pre-registered to extend this owner rather than create a new one.

subsystems.name: Pack-owned canonicalization and tamper-evident rewrite-certificate schema
subsystems.notes: SRP-005/SLM-462. New pack-local subsystem for the symbolic-regression pack, pre-authorized by the downstream_extension_map row for SRP-005 (new_owner_justified: true). That row's extension_points list ['verifier_gate_stack'] as a predicted layering point and constrains the certificate shape to follow the VCE-001 witness pattern; the certificate schema (RewriteCertificateV1) is deliberately templated on evals/semantic_failure.py's VerifierWitnessV1 (schema version + typed evidence + trailing self-digest + fail-closed from_dict), satisfying that constraint. The predicted verifier_gate_stack layering itself is a documented divergence (same precedent as SGS-008): data/verify/stack.py's Gate/GateResult score LLM decode/verifier evidence, which a purely structural algebraic rewrite has no pass/fail outcome to compose with, so this module does not import or extend Gate/GateResult. Initial REWRITE_RULES set is small and exact-IEEE-754-safe by construction (commutative operand ordering for binary +/*, double-negation elimination, abs idempotence) -- none require a numeric side condition, so none can fold a not-yet-fit CoefficientHole or change declared numerical semantics.

subsystems.name: Affine coefficient-dependence analysis and deterministic least-squares fitting
subsystems.notes: SRP-004/SLM-465. The downstream_extension_map row for SRP-004 predicted new_owner_justified: false ('Extends the SRP-003 evaluator'), i.e. adding these symbols directly to symbolic_expr_evaluator's owner_symbols. The real implementation is a self-contained module whose dataclasses (AffineClassificationV1, LeastSquaresFitV1) are not literally defined in symbolic_expr_evaluator.py -- per this map's own rule that a symbol living in a sibling file cannot be added to another module's owner_symbols -- so it is registered as its own subsystem instead, and the divergence is documented here (same precedent as SGS-008/SRP-005). It does reuse symbolic_expr_evaluator.evaluate_vectorized directly (every coefficient-free subtree is evaluated through it, never re-implemented) rather than forking evaluator arithmetic. classify_affine_dependence is a purely structural, data-independent check built on the identical recursive rule set fit_least_squares uses to build the design matrix (via a single-row dummy evaluation), so the two can never silently disagree. Non-affine coefficient holes are unsupported by design -- no optimizer is ever silently substituted.

subsystems.name: Validity, fit, extrapolation, complexity, and Pareto reporting
subsystems.notes: SRP-007/SLM-466. The downstream_extension_map row for SRP-007 predicted new_owner_justified: false ('Reporting layer over SRP-003/004/005'), i.e. adding these symbols directly to an existing owner's owner_symbols. The real implementation's dataclasses (ExpressionEvidenceV1, ParetoFrontV1, SplitEvidenceV1) are not literally defined in symbolic_expr_evaluator.py/symbolic_expr_fit.py/symbolic_expr_canonicalize.py -- per this map's own rule that a symbol living in a sibling file cannot be added to another module's owner_symbols -- so it is registered as its own subsystem instead, and the divergence is documented here (same precedent as SGS-008/SRP-004/SRP-005). It composes rather than re-derives: complexity comes from symbolic_expr_ir.expr_depth_and_node_count, validity/predictions from symbolic_expr_evaluator.evaluate_vectorized, fitted coefficients from symbolic_expr_fit.fit_least_squares (train_indices only -- validation/extrapolation rows are scored afterward, never fit on), and canonical identity from symbolic_expr_canonicalize.canonicalize_expr. Per-expression evidence is reported as a vector (train/validation/extrapolation loss kept separate, never averaged into one number); a split with any numerically invalid row is scored math.inf rather than averaged over only its valid rows, so invalid output can never buy a better score. pareto_front's dominance function follows evals/verified_utility.pareto_dominance's factor-list style, generalized to N objectives, and requires every input record to share one problem_fingerprint/pack_id/resource budget so a comparison artifact never silently mixes identities.

subsystems.name: Deterministic symbolic-regression corpus generation with OOD and leakage controls
subsystems.notes: SRP-008/SLM-471. The downstream_extension_map row for SRP-008 predicted new_owner_justified: false ('Reuses data_corpus_audit (scripts/audit_data_corpora.py) leakage-control machinery for a new corpus, not a new owner'). The generation contract itself (CorpusGenerationConfigV1/CorpusRecordV1/CorpusOracleV1/SymbolicRegressionCorpusV1/CorpusLeakageAuditV1) is not literally defined in scripts/audit_data_corpora.py, so per this map's own sibling-file rule it is registered as its own subsystem instead (same precedent as SGS-008/SRP-004/SRP-005/SRP-007) -- but the row's actual constraint (run leakage/dedup auditing through the existing data_corpus_audit tool, per AGENTS.md's data-quality law) is honored literally: scripts/audit_data_corpora.py gained symbolic_regression_corpus_leakage_report()/--mode symbolic-regression-audit (data.corpus_certification bumped v3->v4), which calls this module's generate_corpus/audit_corpus_leakage directly rather than a second, parallel leakage checker. Canonical-family/topology split assignment reuses harnesses/train_data/split_policy.py's RootFamilySplitPolicyV1 (already-generic root_family_id->split hashing) keyed on the canonicalized expression's hash, so equivalent expressions are assigned a split before any numeric row is sampled, never after. Coefficient placement is guaranteed affine by construction (sum_i(c_i * basis_i(vars)) + offset, mirroring SRP-004/SRP-006's coefficient-free-factor * basis pattern); a candidate whose true coefficients would not be uniquely identifiable from its own train rows (collinear basis terms, detected via symbolic_expr_fit.fit_least_squares.is_rank_deficient) is filtered as collinear_coefficient_terms rather than silently kept with non-recoverable ground truth. The true equation/coefficients live only in CorpusOracleV1; the generated SymbolicRegressionProblemV1's provenance is always left empty, so no oracle field is ever copied onto anything model-visible.

subsystems.name: Bounded canonical enumerative symbolic-regression baseline
subsystems.notes: SRP-009/SLM-472. The downstream_extension_map row for SRP-009 predicted extension_points: [valid_state_search_generic] (the fixed-hole finite-domain CSP controller, dsl/solver/controller.py) as the search backbone. That controller's state model is a fixed set of holes each drawn from a finite domain, solved via backtracking + certificate-backed closure; it does not naturally represent 'generate a variable-shaped tree up to a depth/node budget' without an artificial fixed-arity template encoding that would add real complexity without a matching correctness benefit, especially since this issue's core acceptance criterion (tiny fixtures must match an independent brute-force oracle exactly) is best served by a small, directly-auditable recursive enumerator over the grammar symbolic_expr_ir already declares. Registered as its own subsystem (same precedent as SGS-008/SRP-004/SRP-005/SRP-007) rather than extending valid_state_search_generic's owner_symbols. Composes rather than re-derives: candidate generation reads only symbolic_expr_ir's operator arity table and budgets (never targets/models), canonical identity and dedup come from symbolic_expr_canonicalize.canonicalize_expr, and every unique candidate is scored through symbolic_expr_report.build_evidence_record/pareto_front unmodified. Deduplicates by canonical hash before evaluation; a truncated enumeration (max_states cap reached before natural exhaustion) is structurally forbidden from claiming optimality_claim='exhaustive_under_declared_bounds' (EnumerativeBaselineResultV1.__post_init__ raises on the mismatched combination).

subsystems.name: Optional PySR/SRBench adapter with isolated environment manifest
subsystems.notes: SRP-011/SLM-475. The downstream_extension_map row for SRP-011 already predicted new_owner_justified: true, extension_points: [] ('External, optional dependency by design; isolated deliberately and does not extend any internal owner') -- unlike the SRP-004/005/007/008/009 siblings, this is not a divergence from the pre-registered plan. Never imports pysr/Julia and is never imported by any core path; the external call is injected as a plain str->str raw_output_provider callable, so core tests use mocked/golden output exclusively (no live PySR install exists or is verifiable in this environment). Translation is bidirectional over the already-existing IR: build_adapter_run_input serializes a SymbolicRegressionProblemV1's variable names/operator allowlist/row count (never raw training data) into external runner configuration; parse_external_expression parses the tool's returned infix text back into VarRef/CoefficientHole/OpApply via a hand-rolled tokenizer/recursive-descent parser (no eval/exec), mapping every numeric literal to a fresh CoefficientHole with its value carried in a parallel coefficients tuple so the IR's symbol-only contract is never violated. Every recovered expression is rescored through symbolic_expr_report.build_evidence_record unmodified -- an external tool's self-reported loss is never trusted or persisted. Any operator/identifier outside the pack's declared grammar (PySR's '^'/'square', etc.) is reported in unsupported_operators rather than approximated; any external-call exception, timeout, or malformed-output parse failure produces a typed non-'ok' AdapterRunResultV1 with evidence=None (enforced in __post_init__), never a fabricated benchmark loss.

subsystems.name: Proof-scoped e-graph/equivalence-region experiment (EXP-SR-8)
subsystems.notes: RSP-004/SLM-479. The downstream_extension_map row for RSP-004 predicted new_owner_justified: false ('Runs SRP-005's canonicalization/rewrite-certificate work through the campaign contract'), i.e. no new owner beyond dsl_pack_registry_canonical/experiment_campaign. The e-graph union-find contract itself (EGraph/ENodeV1/RewriteApplicationV1/CertificateVerificationV1) is not literally defined in symbolic_expr_canonicalize.py or experiment_campaign.py, so per this map's own sibling-file rule it is registered as its own subsystem instead (same precedent as SGS-008/SRP-004/005/007/008) -- but the row's actual constraint is honored literally: every union this module performs carries the certificate symbolic_expr_canonicalize.apply_rewrite_rule already produces (REWRITE_RULES is the sole seed, no new rewrite semantics), and the experiment runs through the pre-registered SIE-001 exp_sr_catalogue.py identity (family_id 'exp-sr-8', campaign_manifest_sha256 referenced in the results doc) rather than inventing a parallel campaign. Extraction is a cycle-safe bottom-up fixed point (safe_representatives): rules like double-negation elimination union a class with one of its own descendants, which can leave e-nodes only reconstructible by re-entering their own class -- a naive recursive walk over an arbitrary member recurses forever, so extraction only ever selects an already-proven-acyclic representative per class. Every rewrite application is independently re-verified numerically (verify_rewrite_numerically, NaN-aware) before counting toward the locked primary endpoint egraph_certified_equivalence_rate (kill_threshold=1.0/lt: any uncertified or numerically-unverified union kills the candidate arm). Measured result (docs/design/exp-sr-8-egraph-equivalence-experiment.{json,md}): e-graph regions matched canonical-hash dedup's unique-form set and Pareto frontier exactly on the fixture corpus -- expected, since SRP-005's current REWRITE_RULES are each complexity-non-increasing and confluent, so e-graph saturation is mathematically guaranteed to converge to the same fixed point canonicalize_expr already computes. Per SLM-479's own acceptance criterion ('Result remains default-off regardless of fixture win'), nothing in dsl/symbolic_regression_pack.py or any production canonicalization path imports this module.

subsystems.name: Prospective certified macro/library-learning experiment (EXP-SR-9)
subsystems.notes: RSP-005/SLM-480. The downstream_extension_map row for RSP-005 predicted new_owner_justified: false ('Runs pack + artifact owners through the campaign contract'), i.e. no new owner beyond dsl_pack_registry_canonical/certified_completion_artifact/experiment_campaign. The macro-library contract itself (MacroLibraryV1/MacroEntryV1/mining and selection functions) is not literally defined in dsl/pack.py or dsl/grammar/fastpath/completion_artifact.py, so per this map's own sibling-file rule it is registered as its own subsystem instead (same precedent as SGS-008/SRP-004/005/007/008/009/RSP-004) -- but the row's actual constraint is honored literally for the piece that IS genuinely reused: Rsp005CampaignV1 builds a real autoresearch.experiment_campaign.ExperimentCampaignV1 and runs it through the shared autoresearch.storage.CampaignStore, exactly like SIE-002/RSP-004 (no forked campaign machinery). Every admitted macro is a closed (0-arity), content-addressed (macro_id=sha256(expansion_expr)-derived) recurring canonical subtree -- never a parametrized/anti-unified template -- mined exclusively from corpus_split=='train' symbolic-regression records (never a held-out/eval AST) and evaluated prospectively on the frozen corpus_split=='test' slice; expansion is exactly parse_expr of the stored canonical string, independently re-verified numerically (verify_expansion_equivalence, NaN-aware) against a real occurrence rather than trusted by construction, mirroring RSP-004's verify_rewrite_numerically pattern. Content-addressed macro_ids mean admitting or retiring a macro never renumbers another macro's identity. This module does not touch, extend, or compete with data/macro_induction.py or models/dsl_tokenizer.py -- that is a separate, production, compiler-hard, version-governed macro system over the OpenUI DSL token stream; this module mines macros over the unrelated symbolic-regression AST domain and stays evaluation-only, imported by no production canonicalization path.

subsystems.name: Prompt-to-partial-requirements prediction behind the advisory-only seam
subsystems.notes: SIE-003/SLM-477. The downstream_extension_map row for SIE-003 predicted new_owner_justified: false ('Extends SGS-003/004's prompt_requirements owner'), i.e. adding these symbols directly to prompt_requirements.py's owner_symbols. The real dataclasses/classifier are not literally defined in prompt_requirements.py or semantic_plan.py -- per this map's own sibling-file rule it is registered as its own subsystem instead (same precedent as SGS-008/SRP-004/005/007/008/009/011). Honest scope note on 'authorized factor families' (AC: 'No factor without an oracle ceiling is promoted into the model merely for convenience'): EXP-SR-1 (SIE-002/SLM-476) authorized roles+bindings (not archetype/style_layout); DEFAULT_AUTHORIZED_FACTOR_FAMILIES=('style_layout',) remains an explicit placeholder for this seam's archetype target — SIE-004 gates RequirementFact emission on the real SIE-002-mapped set; prediction_to_requirement_fact fails closed (returns None) for any factor family outside the caller-supplied authorized set. TinyBagOfWordsClassifier is a from-scratch, pure-NumPy multinomial-Naive-Bayes baseline (the issue's own 'tiny trainable baseline') trained only on role='positive' (never the corpus's deliberately-corrupted contrast-negative) rows of the committed openui_hard_valid_v1 corpus, split at the source-program level before train/held-out (EXP-SR-2's own declared leakage control). Calibration/abstention reuses evals/VCE-010's dsl.grammar.fastpath.trust_train.gate_calibration_report directly rather than a second calibration mechanism; resolve_confidence_threshold's fallback (abstain on every call) is exercised for real against the actual fixture corpus, which this tiny baseline does not clear a 5% selective-risk bar on -- an honest negative result, not hidden. predict_factor's signature accepts only prompt text (no plan/oracle parameter exists), and prediction_to_requirement_fact always emits provenance='predicted'/authority='advisory-learned' (RequirementProvenance has no 'gold' value at all), so gold data has no path into production inference. requirements_hard_prune_allowed already requires COMPILER_AUTHORED_CERTIFIED evidence this predictor never produces, so exact legal support is unaffected by the predictor being on or off.

contract_version_governance.ci_wiring: .github/workflows/ci.yml python-static job, step "Certify the repository ownership map"
contract_version_governance.precommit_wiring: scripts/check_changed.py OWNERSHIP_MAP_FILES set triggers python -m scripts.verify_ownership_map when a watched file changes

checkpoint_load_enforcement.description: OUTPUT_CONTRACT_VERSION is enforced a second, independent time at model-checkpoint load: require_current_output_contract() raises OutputContractError on any mismatch. A stale checkpoint is rejected outright, never silently reinterpreted (SGS-002 acceptance criterion).
